stories.title: Trade body urges more HGV stops after driver fined
stories.summary: The Road Haulage Association says HGV drivers need better facilities to stop and rest.

stories.title: Woman felt 'violated' sister's medical records were accessed
stories.summary: Angelina Sabatino says her sister was "disgusted" when she learned her details had been viewed.

stories.title: Parish councillor says erosion is panicking village
stories.summary: Stephen Pavey says coastal erosion in the area "needs to be dealt with".

stories.title: Hospital therapy dog Rolo makes his final rounds
stories.summary: Rolo, once rescued from a puppy farm in 2013, has brought joy to patients as a Pets As Therapy dog.

stories.title: Charity to end after 30 years over financial risks

stories.title: Council worker's police order for protest flag removal

stories.title: Therapist struck off for sharing child's details

stories.title: Doctor who licked beer off colleague can work again
stories.summary: The Medical Practitioners Tribunal Service says Dr Mark Johnson is again fit to practise.

stories.title: Artist creates graffiti studio made entirely of felt
stories.summary: Lucy Sparrow is known across the world for her art exhibitions made entirely of felt fabric.

stories.title: 'Doctors put my sickness down to pregnancy - but it was abuse'

stories.title: Roads closed as firefighters tackle town centre blaze
stories.summary: About six crews are called to the three-storey building in Ipswich.

stories.title: Town centre Post Office reopens in new location
stories.summary: The branch has relocated after being forced to move out of its previous premises.
